title: SEC enforcement actions
html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0"><channel><title>SEC Litigation Releases</title><link>https://www.sec.gov/litigation/litreleases</link>
<item><title>SEC v. Acme Advisors LLC</title><link>https://www.sec.gov/litigation/litreleases/lr-26012</link><pubDate>Tue, 30 Apr 2024 00:00:00 EDT</pubDate>
<description>Lit. Rel. No. 26012. The SEC charged Acme Advisors LLC with violating Exchange Act Rule 15l-1 and 17 CFR 248.30; the firm agreed to pay a $1,200,000 civil penalty.</description></item>
<item><title>SEC v. Jane Doe</title><link>https://www.sec.gov/litigation/litreleases/lr-26013</link><pubDate>Fri, 3 May 2024 00:00:00 EDT</pubDate>
<description>Lit. Rel. No. 26013. Final judgment against Jane Doe, a former CFO, ordering disgorgement of $800,000 and barring her from serving as an officer or director.</description></item>
</channel></rss>
